sentiment.instructions: How would a typical reader judge the overall sentiment of this text?

positive.description: A typical reader would see the text as expressing a favorable view or a pleasant emotion.
examples: Not even 20 pages into Paper Towns and the book centers around the night of May 5th. I know its gonna be a good one now!

neutral.description: A typical reader would see the text as informative or as lacking any clear sentiment.
examples: I may be sleep deprived but I promise you that some kid at Dunkin today looked like a sprout.

negative.description: A typical reader would see the text as expressing an unfavorable view or an unpleasant emotion.
examples: The tragedy of only thinking up hilarious tweets for the Summer Olympics now is that in four years there may be no place for them.
